ea771f613d142b48.description: About the Role Future Pipe Industries is seeking a General Manager Sales to join their team in Dammam, Eastern Region. This full-time role is open to Saudi Nationals and requires a minimum of 10 years of experience. The General Manager Sales will be responsible for developing the sales team and the annual sales plan in alignment with the company’s strategy across various market sectors to achieve yearly targets, maximize margins, and meet objectives. The role also involves developing and maintaining key accounts and supervising the sales team to achieve set budgets. Key Responsibilities Develop and achieve sales targets within various market sectors. Build a comprehensive understanding of client and market requirements, aligning them with company objectives. Increase market share and explore new market opportunities. Review and update sales achievements against budgets on a monthly basis. Ensure timely submission of all quotations and tenders with necessary documentation. Negotiate, control, and award projects in line with established targets. Improve customer interaction, satisfaction, and retention by enhancing service standards and technical skills. Maintain and develop relationships with existing key accounts and establish new key accounts across different market sectors. Liaise with the Credit Controller to ensure timely receipt of all account payments. Team Leadership and Development Motivate and lead a high-performance team by attracting, recruiting, and retaining qualified team members. Enhance the work environment to promote employee engagement and team effectiveness. Conduct annual performance appraisals, providing feedback on strengths, areas for improvement, and development opportunities. Establish Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for individual units, ensuring alignment with FPI’s mission and vision. Identify key positions and ensure succession plans are in place for target staff. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in a relevant sales leadership role. Proven ability to develop and execute sales strategies. Strong understanding of market development, budget management, and customer service principles. Demonstrated experience in leading and motivating sales teams. Communication Scope The General Manager Sales will engage in extensive communication both internally and externally to fulfill the responsibilities of the role. Internal: VP Sales & Marketing, Area Sales Representative, Marketing Manager, Regional Proposal Manager, Technical and Sales Support (TSS), Projects Department, Production Department, Delivery Department, Legal, Finance, PED. External: Customers, Consultants, Contractors, End Users, and FPI Representatives.

ea99ae513e631233.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة أول ريادي عن مصور فوتوغرافي للانضمام إلى فريقها في ينبع، المدينة المنورة. يتطلب هذا الدور، بدوام كامل، تجهيز معدات التصوير وتوثيق المناظر الطبيعية والأشخاص والفعاليات المختلفة. كما يشمل الدور إعداد التقارير المتعلقة بالعمل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية القيام بالتصوير الفوتوغرافي وتصوير الفيديو باستخدام الكاميرات الاحترافية والهواتف الذكية، بما يتوافق مع متطلبات كل مشروع. تنفيذ جلسات التصوير في المواقع الخارجية، المحلات التجارية، المنشآت، ومواقع العملاء المحددة ضمن نطاق العمل المتفق عليه. تتطلب طبيعة الوظيفة العمل الميداني بشكل أساسي. فرز وتعديل ومونتاج الصور والمقاطع المصورة، وتجهيزها للنشر حسب التكليف. تسليم الملفات الأصلية والنهائية في المواعيد المحددة ورفعها على المنصات المطلوبة. تجهيز كاميرات التصوير الفوتوغرافي والرقمي قبل البدء بالعمل. دراسة وتحليل موضوع الصورة وموقع التقاطها وظروفه، واختيار الكاميرا المناسبة، وضبط عوامل التصوير مثل المسافة وفتحة العدسة، وتحديد اتجاه وزاوية التصوير. تصوير المناظر الطبيعية، الأشخاص، الأحداث، والمناسبات المتنوعة. تحميض وتظهير الصور الفوتوغرافية. معالجة الصور الرقمية باستخدام برامج الحاسب الآلي وطباعتها. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال التصوير الفوتوغرافي. القدرة على استخدام معدات التصوير الفوتوغرافي والفيديو المتنوعة. مهارات في برامج تعديل الصور والمونتاج. متطلبات العمل الالتزام بالمواعيد النهائية لتسليم المشاريع. القدرة على العمل الميداني والتنقل بين المواقع المختلفة حسب طبيعة العمل. المرونة في التعامل مع متطلبات المشاريع المتغيرة. بيئة العمل تتطلب هذه الوظيفة العمل بدوام كامل في مدينة ينبع، المدينة المنورة، مع التركيز على المهام الميدانية في مواقع العملاء والمواقع الخارجية. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

eaeaa9dd7ba55c73.description: مطلوب شيف سوشي محترف 🍣 نبحث عن شيف متخصص في إعداد وتحضير السوشي، لديه خبرة ومهارة في ابتكار النكهات وتقديم الأطباق باحترافية. الشروط: خبرة في إعداد السوشي بمختلف أنواعه. إتقان تحضير وتقديم السوشي. الإبداع والاهتمام بجودة الطعام. الالتزام بالنظافة وسلامة الغذاء. الجدية والاحترافية في العمل. موقع العمل: جدة – داخل كرفان كبير مجهز للعمل. ساعات العمل: من 5:00 مساءً إلى 1:00 بعد منتصف الليل. للمهتمين، يرجى التواصل وإرسال الخبرات والأعمال السابقة. Sushi Chef Wanted 🍣 We are looking for an experienced Sushi Chef with professional skills in sushi preparation, creative flavors, and food presentation. Requirements: Experience in preparing different types of sushi. Professional sushi-making skills. Creativity and attention to food quality. High standards of hygiene and food safety. Commitment and professionalism. Work Location: Jeddah – Working inside a large, well-equipped food trailer. Working Hours: 5:00 PM – 1:00 AM. Interested candidates are welcome to contact us and share their experience and previous work.

eafd6820e3d66dd2.description: About the Role Bupa Arabia is seeking an Endocrinology Consultant to join its team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time position requires a medical professional with 5-10 years of experience in endocrinology, focusing on comprehensive patient care and adherence to modern healthcare principles. Key Responsibilities Conduct thorough medical assessments, including patient histories, physical examinations, and the ordering and interpretation of specialized diagnostic tests for endocrine disorders. Diagnose and manage a wide range of endocrine conditions, such as diabetes mellitus, thyroid disorders, adrenal disorders, pituitary disorders, and reproductive hormone disorders. Develop and implement personalized treatment plans for patients, integrating evidence-based medicine, patient preferences, and individualized endocrine care. Monitor and manage chronic endocrine conditions, providing ongoing care, medication management, and lifestyle interventions to optimize patient health. Collaborate with primary care physicians, specialists, nurses, and allied healthcare professionals to ensure coordinated and comprehensive patient care. Provide education and counseling to patients and their families regarding endocrine disorders, lifestyle modifications, medication management, and self-care strategies. Utilize both in-person and telemedicine platforms for consultations, patient progress monitoring, and virtual follow-up care as appropriate. Practice population health management by identifying and addressing endocrine health issues at a population level, implementing preventive measures, and promoting health awareness. Embrace value-based care principles, focusing on optimizing patient outcomes and reducing healthcare costs through care coordination, preventive measures, and efficient resource utilization. Stay updated with the latest advancements in endocrinology, including new treatment modalities, guidelines, population health management strategies, and value-based care models. Maintain accurate and detailed medical records for patients, ensuring compliance with legal and regulatory requirements. Participate in quality improvement initiatives, research activities, and clinical audits to enhance patient care and outcomes in the field of endocrinology. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will possess a strong clinical background in endocrinology, demonstrated through 5-10 years of relevant experience. This role requires a commitment to patient-centered care, continuous professional development, and the ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary healthcare team. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, with responsibilities extending to Jeddah. The role involves working within a dynamic healthcare setting, collaborating with various medical professionals to deliver high-quality patient care. Application Process Candidates interested in this Endocrinology Consultant position at Bupa Arabia are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

ea8dbc8dae427fc4.description: About Aleph Aleph is a global leader in digital advertising, representing major platforms such as TikTok, Amazon, Google, and approximately 55 others across over 130 markets. The company's mission is to enable advertisers and brands to leverage the full potential of these platforms, fostering long-term partnerships and creating opportunities for effective advertising at both local and global scales. Aleph is a fast-growing, innovative organization where individual contributions have a direct impact. Role Overview: Client Partner Aleph is seeking a Client Partner to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role focuses on driving advertising revenue growth by managing a portfolio of advertisers and agencies. The Client Partner will build relationships with senior stakeholders and deliver consultative, insight-led solutions to help clients achieve their brand and performance objectives on various platforms. This digital advertising sales position combines new business development, account expansion, campaign strategy, and cross-functional collaboration. Key Responsibilities Manage and grow a book of business, achieving quarterly and annual revenue targets through new spend, renewals, and upsells. Develop and implement account growth strategies that benefit both the platforms represented and the advertisers. Create and deliver consultative sales presentations demonstrating how advertising solutions connect brands with audiences and deliver outcomes. Maintain a robust pipeline, accurate forecasting, and disciplined account planning to meet targets. Establish and cultivate senior relationships with advertisers and agency stakeholders, serving as a trusted advisor. Lead strategic quarterly business reviews (QBRs), planning sessions, and joint business plans, aligning on objectives, audience, creative approach, and measurement. Identify client business challenges and translate them into clear media strategies and platform solutions. Collaborate with clients to build and execute effective campaigns, interpret performance data, and recommend optimizations and next steps. Guide the measurement approach, including KPIs, attribution, brand lift, and reporting, and assist clients in navigating evolving measurement environments. Work closely with the Account Manager to monitor active campaigns, revenue pacing, and in-flight performance, proactively identifying risks and opportunities to ensure delivery and accelerate incremental spend. Stay informed on product updates and the broader digital media landscape, translating market changes into client opportunities. Collaborate with internal partners (measurement, creative, operations, product, client solutions) to ensure a strong client experience and prompt issue resolution. Contribute to team knowledge-sharing and, where applicable, mentor and onboard new team members. Required Qualifications and Experience 4+ years of experience in digital media, platform, or ad-tech sales, with a proven record of exceeding quotas and growing a book of business. Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong relationships with marketing decision-makers at brands and agencies. Excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders. Strong understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem, including formats, measurement, targeting, and brand versus performance objectives. Comfortable working with data and capable of translating performance signals into actionable insights and clear client recommendations. Experience selling across both brand and performance objectives, ideally including video ad solutions. Ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, high-change environments, with strong collaboration and problem-solving skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, requiring 2-5 years of relevant experience. The role operates within a dynamic, global environment where innovation and collaboration are key.

ea3ecf4b65bff826.description: About the Role Saudi Air Navigation Services is seeking an R&D Automation Systems Engineer to support initiatives related to the deployment of next-generation Air Traffic Management (ATM) systems. This is a full-time position in Saudi Arabia, suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience. Role Purpose and Context The primary purpose of this role is to contribute to and support R&D initiatives focused on advanced Air Traffic Management (ATM) systems. The engineer will ensure that these systems align with SANS operational needs, enabling the delivery of Air Traffic Control services in a manner that is safe, efficient, scalable, and cyber-resilient. All activities will be conducted within established KPIs, agreed budgets, and adopted policies and procedures. Key Responsibilities Analyze and document complex system requirements for R&D initiatives. Participate in thorough evaluations of potential vendors and their solutions. Support the testing and validation processes for cloud-native, Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) platforms. Ensure system developments meet SANS operational requirements for safe and efficient Air Traffic Control services. Contribute to the development of scalable and cyber-resilient ATM systems. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of relevant professional experience. Demonstrated ability to analyze and document technical requirements. Understanding of Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) and cloud-native platforms is beneficial. Experience or knowledge in system testing and validation processes. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Saudi Arabia, contributing to a team focused on advanced Air Traffic Management technologies. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply for this R&D Automation Systems Engineer position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

ea3f476054887d15.description: About the Role Duncan & Ross is seeking an Electrical Engineer to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves leading all electrical engineering activities related to the restoration of facility buildings and hangars. The primary objective is to ensure that medium- and low-voltage (MV/LV) power systems, emergency power, and switchgear are safely restored, fully tested, and returned to service in compliance with approved designs, applicable codes, and company standards. Key Responsibilities Assess affected electrical systems on site and recommend appropriate repair or replacement solutions. Plan and coordinate power shutdowns and electrical isolations in liaison with Operations and HSE departments. Develop the electrical technical input for scopes of work, tender documents, and bills of quantities. Perform technical evaluations of bidder and contractor proposals. Review and approve designs, shop drawings, material submittals, and protection coordination studies. Supervise the installation, testing, energization, and commissioning of electrical systems. Monitor contractor performance, quality, and compliance with the approved scope and schedule. Verify and approve as-built drawings, test reports, and handover documentation. Role Context The Electrical Engineer will play a critical role in ensuring the safe and compliant restoration of essential electrical infrastructure. This involves a comprehensive approach from initial assessment through to final commissioning and handover, adhering strictly to established engineering principles and safety protocols.

ea473454acc8b6c1.description: About the Role Atlas Copco is seeking an Aftermarket Sales Engineer for its Compressor Technique business area in Riyadh. This full-time role focuses on driving sales and building customer relationships for aftermarket solutions. The Aftermarket Sales Engineer will identify customer needs, provide technical advice, and promote spare parts and services to enhance equipment performance and reliability, ultimately supporting customers in maximizing the value and lifespan of their industrial equipment investments. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential customers, identifying their aftermarket needs. Provide expert technical consultation to support customers’ equipment maintenance and upgrade decisions. Prepare and present sales proposals, quotations, and negotiate contract terms aligned with company policies. Collaborate with internal teams such as service, engineering, and logistics to ensure timely delivery and customer satisfaction. Monitor market trends and competitor activities to identify new sales opportunities and contribute to strategic planning. Participate in customer events, trade shows, and product trainings to enhance technical knowledge and network. Maintain accurate sales reports and forecasts using company CRM and reporting tools. Candidate Profile We are looking for a proactive and customer-oriented professional with a strong technical background in sales. Experience within the industrial equipment or compressor sectors is preferred. The ideal candidate will possess excellent communication and negotiation skills to effectively understand and address customer challenges. This role requires the ability to manage multiple accounts and projects simultaneously while maintaining a high standard of service excellence. Required Skills and Attributes Strong technical background in sales, preferably in industrial equipment or compressor sectors. Excellent communication and negotiation skills. Ability to manage multiple accounts and projects simultaneously. Commitment to maintaining a high standard of service excellence. Deep understanding of product applications and aftersales solutions. Ability to collaborate cross-functionally with service and engineering teams. Work Environment and Development Atlas Copco offers a supportive and inclusive work environment that encourages innovation and collaboration. The company is dedicated to continuous learning and professional development through comprehensive training programs and career growth opportunities. You will work within a diverse and skilled team that values open communication and mutual respect.

ea6009e39d4c9be2.description: About the Role of Maintenance Supervisor HUDSON is seeking a Maintenance Supervisor to join its team in the Eastern Province, specifically in Al Jubail and Dammam. This full-time role involves overseeing the maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of various heavy equipment and machinery. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Perform maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of heavy equipment. Manage the upkeep of cranes, excavators, forklifts, super suckers, and hydrojetting machines. Ensure the operational readiness of trucks, trailers, buses, and dump trucks. Oversee the maintenance of generators, tower lights, Dyna, and pickups. Implement preventive and corrective maintenance programs. Required Skills and Expertise Strong mechanical, hydraulic, electrical, and technical knowledge is essential for this role. Demonstrated expertise in both preventive and corrective maintenance. Proficiency in workshop operations and effective management of technician teams. Good computer skills for reporting and maintaining comprehensive maintenance documentation. Proven strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess a minimum of 5 years of experience, with up to 10 years preferred, in the maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of heavy equipment. This includes a broad range of machinery such as cranes, excavators, forklifts, super suckers, hydrojetting machines, trucks, trailers, buses, dump trucks, generators, tower lights, Dyna, and pickups. Work Environment and Compensation This is a full-time position based in the Eastern Province, covering operations in Al Jubail and Dammam. The salary offered for this role ranges from SAR 2,500 to SAR 4,000 per month. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this Maintenance Supervisor position with HUDSON.

ea60c17f21f931e4.description: About KEO International Consultants KEO International Consultants is a creative enterprise recognized for its innovation and comprehensive end-to-end services in planning, design, and project delivery within the built and natural environments. With over 60 years of experience, KEO has contributed to significant global projects and is recognized by ENR as one of the Top 225 International Design Firms and a Top 20 International PM/CM Firm. World Architecture ranks KEO as the 51st largest global architecture firm and the #1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2024 WA100 Survey. The Role of Infrastructure Engineer KEO International Consultants is seeking Infrastructure Engineers to join its team. This full-time position is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience. The role involves contributing to various projects within a supportive environment that prioritizes professional development and employee well-being. Key Responsibilities Applying a strong understanding of engineering drawings, technical specifications, construction methods, and applicable codes and standards. Coordinating with multidisciplinary project teams, contractors, clients, and specialist consultants. Utilizing engineering software and digital tools relevant to the discipline, such as AutoCAD, Revit, Civil 3D, Navisworks, ETABS, SAP2000, or other discipline-specific applications. Adhering to quality assurance and control procedures, preparing technical reports, and managing construction documentation. Working effectively in a project-based environment to meet demanding project schedules. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in a relevant engineering discipline from a recognized university. A master's degree or relevant postgraduate qualification is an advantage for selected senior positions. Relevant professional experience in engineering consultancy, construction supervision, design, infrastructure, or large-scale building projects. Demonstrated experience appropriate to the advertised role and level of responsibility. Required Skills Strong communication, coordination, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Proficiency with relevant engineering software and digital tools. Knowledge of quality assurance and control procedures. The company promotes health and well-being through on-demand counseling services and regular workplace clinics. Employees can participate in community events such as sports days, fun-runs, in-house sports teams, and beach clean-ups. In addition to a competitive package and benefits, KEO offers policies including hybrid working arrangements, individual athletic sponsorship, study assistance sponsorship, and employee referral rewards.

ea7c8b1f8677e44d.description: About the Role Ash Sharqiyah Operations & Maintenance Company (ASHOMCo) is seeking a Financial Controller to lead its finance function. This full-time position is based in the Eastern region of Saudi Arabia, covering locations such as Dhahran, Buqayq, and Ras Tannurah. The Financial Controller will report directly to the Chief Executive Officer and will be responsible for providing comprehensive financial management services to the company, its management team, and the plant owner. Key Responsibilities Manage the company’s financial data, general ledger, payroll, and financial reporting on a day-to-day basis. Ensure that all accounts, books, and records are maintained to a professional standard, comply with KSA standards, and are readily auditable. Deliver accurate and timely monthly budgetary reports to ASHOMCo management and to the owner, in line with applicable agreements. Implement strong budgetary control and analytical practices, including monitoring commitments and expenditure against O&M budgets. Analyze variances and forecast outturns to support early corrective actions. Support the business plan, inventory valuation, stock audits, and the procurement function, working closely with budget holders and the operations and maintenance teams. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in financial control or a similar senior finance role. Demonstrated experience in budgetary control and financial analysis is essential. Required Skills Strong analytical skills for variance analysis and forecasting. Proficiency in financial reporting and general ledger management. Ability to ensure compliance with financial standards and regulations. Effective communication and collaboration skills for working with management, owners, and operational teams. Work Environment This is a full-time position within ASHOMCo, operating in the Eastern region of Saudi Arabia, specifically covering Dhahran, Buqayq, and Ras Tannurah. The role involves direct interaction with the CEO and various internal and external stakeholders. Application Process Further details regarding the application process and salary will be disclosed to qualified candidates.

ead99b4f2d2c1f21.description: About the Role Clear Engineering Consultants is seeking a Senior Accountant to join its Finance Department in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires a detail-oriented professional with strong experience in accounting operations, financial reporting, budgeting, and cost control. The ideal candidate will contribute to the financial integrity and operational efficiency of the company. Role Overview The Senior Accountant will be responsible for managing key financial processes, ensuring compliance with accounting standards and local regulations. This position demands strong analytical capabilities and the ability to work effectively within a professional team. Previous experience within engineering consultancy or construction companies is highly preferred for this role. Key Responsibilities Managing daily accounting activities. Preparing comprehensive financial statements. Handling monthly closing procedures accurately. Monitoring and controlling project costs effectively. Ensuring compliance with applicable accounting standards and Saudi regulations. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. Minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant accounting experience. Previous experience in engineering consultancy or construction companies is highly preferred. Strong knowledge of International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS). Experience in preparing financial statements, financial reports, and monthly and annual closing. Experience in budgeting, financial forecasting, and cost control. Good knowledge of VAT, ZATCA regulations, and Saudi tax requirements. Strong hands-on experience with Odoo ERP system is required. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Microsoft Excel. Professional certifications such as SOCPA, CMA, ACCA, or CPA are an advantage. Required Skills Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills. Excellent attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines. Good communication skills in both Arabic and English. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within the Finance Department of Clear Engineering Consultants. ea3986e645e7f697.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة المجال العربي عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية، حيث سيساهم المهندس في تصميم وتطوير وتنفيذ المشاريع الميكانيكية المتنوعة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية لمشاريع الأعمال الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات التوزيع لأنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية بناءً على تعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها بفعالية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل الحالية ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. فهم عميق لمبادئ التصميم الميكانيكي وأنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. القدرة على إعداد المخططات الفنية والتقارير الهندسية. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الميكانيكي ضمن فريق متخصص في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية، في بيئة عمل ديناميكية تركز على تنفيذ المشاريع الهندسية بكفاءة ودقة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. التقديم نرحب بالمرشحين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة للتقدم لهذا الدور. سيتم تحديد الراتب بعد المقابلة.

eaaef38af5edb616.description: JOB PURPOSE In collaboration with the Manager and Lead, the role is responsible for formulating and quantifying the Bank risk appetite metrics, measuring the Bank risk profile, and recommending any necessary corrective actions. The role contributes to the development of enterprise-wide quantitative risk measurement models, methodologies, and techniques such as FAS 30/IFRS 9 risk modelling, economic capital, risk rating models. The role must provide an independent high-level risk oversight and reporting of the Bank s financial and non-financial risk profile. The role provides technical guidance to the Portfolio Risk and Reporting team for the undertaking of credit risk management activities at the Bank focusing on developing and implementing appropriate portfolio risk management framework and guidelines, credit risk modelling and risk analytics covering all aspects of Bank-wide risk management. The role also provides technical guidance to the junior team members. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES Portfolio Risk Management and Reporting: Prepare the Bank-wide Risk Report covering risk governance, assessment of credit, market and operational risks, and other relevant reports especially analysis, recommendations, and write-up. Contribute to the formulation of Bank-wide risk appetite framework (RAF) and ensuring RAF is cascaded down to Bank s day-to-day business via Target Market and Risk Acceptance Criteria (TM/RAC). Review, update and maintain the Bank-wide Exposure Management Framework covering financing operations, treasury and investment activities. Develop, review, and maintain an Economic Capital Adequacy Framework and Model and its related guidelines. Review, update, and maintain risk models and parameters such as Probability of Default (PD), Loss-Given-Default (LGD), Exposure-at-Default (EAD), correlations, etc. Undertake the development, review, and maintenance of IFRS 9 Expected Credit Loss (ECL) methodologies and models and determine the level of impairment and provisions based on IFRS9 for the Bank-wide portfolio. Develop and maintain Bank-wide risk adjusted return on capital (RAROC) framework and analytics. Develop and implement a stress-testing framework for the Bank s economic capital adequacy model that enables proactive assessment of the potential impacts of changing market and financial conditions on financial sustainability in the short, medium and longer term and its impact on the credit rating of the Bank. Prepare portfolio data for internal and external processing, e.g. submission to credit data pooling consortium of MDBs and International FIs on a periodic basis. Monitor the risk profile of sovereign and non-sovereign operations financing portfolio, including asset credit quality and concentration levels, to ensure that risk profile is within the established limits. Review and provide feedback on new policies and guidelines drafted by the Finance Complex and Operations-related complexes, particularly relating to credit risk. Contribute to the implementation of Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) system, tools and framework. Collaborate with the IMDT for the development of information systems that produce reports required for its independent risk reporting to President and BED Committees. Assist in the coordination efforts with concerned Departments on all matters relating to ratings of IsDB or instruments for IsDB and along with other Divisions of Risk Management Department including sukuk issuances and providing risk management input for annual reports. Support and contribute to the process of Bank s external rating assessments including preparation and collation of the rating file for each external rating agency. Provide support to the Management and relevant units on high level portfolio risks and reporting. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES Operational Excellence: Provide technical guidance and review the work delivered by lesser experienced team members. Monitor the effective implementation and adherence to respective risk management policies, procedures and controls so that all relevant procedural / legislative requirements are fulfilled. Keep abreast of the latest developments, regulations and leading practices in the field and propose any necessary actions. Propose and implement process improvements to increase efficiency, effectiveness and compliance of the related operations. Contribute to the preparation of work plans and financial budget for the portfolio risk and reporting function and monitor actual expenditure against the approved budget. SKILLS & NECESSARY KNOWLEDGE Advanced knowledge of Statistical Analysis, Programming Language such as Python / R / SQL, Financial Modeling and Reporting Practical experience in implementing frameworks for economic capital and loan loss provisioning Good knowledge of Multi-Lateral Development Banks (MDBs) in Credit Risk Hands on experiences in developing risk policies and guidelines Country risk assessment methodology Corporate and Project finance, and Financial Institutions Risk Assessment MDBs Ratings Methodologies of the Rating Agencies IFRS 9 and Credit Risk Modelling Islamic Finance Stress Testing Governance, Risk and control Analytical Thinking Problem Solving Stakeholders and People Management Desired Candidate Profile ACADEMIC AND PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS Master s degree in Economics / Finance / Risk Management / Mathematics / Business Administration or related discipline. Professional certifications like CFA/PRM/FRM/CQF or equivalent is preferred. Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in the risk management function, ideally 3 years in Multilateral Development Banks. Languages: English: Mandatory | Arabic: Preferred | French: Preferred

ea5c6e3f1ab9aab0.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ايوان للتجارة عن مراقب خدمات عامة للانضمام إلى فريقها في بريدة، القصيم. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومناسب للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، حيث يركز على مراجعة وتنسيق أنشطة موظفي الخدمات العامة لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية. الهدف من الوظيفة يهدف مراقب الخدمات العامة إلى الإشراف على عمليات الخدمات العامة وتطويرها، بما في ذلك تحديد المهام والواجبات، وتحسين إجراءات العمل، ومعالجة المشكلات التشغيلية. كما يشمل الدور تقييم أداء الموظفين وتنمية مهاراتهم لضمان تحقيق الأهداف التنظيمية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراجعة وتنسيق أعمال وأنشطة موظفي الخدمات العامة، وتحديد مهامهم وواجباتهم بناءً على حجم العمل والأولويات وقدرات العاملين. إعداد وتطوير برامج وإجراءات العمل، وتنسيق الأنشطة مع الوحدات التنظيمية الأخرى ذات الصلة. دراسة مشكلات العمل، وتحديد أسبابها، واقتراح بدائل الحلول الممكنة، واختيار الحل الأنسب، ومتابعة التنفيذ والتقييم. تقييم أداء موظفي الخدمات العامة ومدى التزامهم باللوائح التنظيمية المتعلقة بمجال العمل. تحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية الفردية للموظفين وتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منهجي. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على مراجعة وتنسيق الأنشطة وتحديد المهام بفعالية. مهارات في إعداد وتطوير إجراءات العمل. القدرة على تحليل المشكلات واقتراح الحلول. مهارات تقييم الأداء وتحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة بريدة، القصيم، وتتطلب التزامًا بالعمل ضمن فريق لدعم العمليات اليومية للخدمات العامة في شركة ايوان للتجارة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم.

eacf7042c7985129.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة عبدالعزيز الجاسر التجارية القابضة عن موظف استقبال للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى توفير نقطة اتصال أولى احترافية وفعالة للزوار والعملاء، بالإضافة إلى إدارة الاتصالات الهاتفية والمهام الإدارية الأساسية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال الزوار والعملاء والترحيب بهم، وتحديد متطلباتهم، وتقديم المعلومات اللازمة لهم. إبلاغ الموظفين المعنيين بوجود المراجعين والعملاء وتوجيههم إليهم. استقبال المكالمات الهاتفية الواردة والرد على الاستفسارات أو تحويلها إلى القسم المختص. إجراء الاتصالات الداخلية اللازمة للحصول على المعلومات المطلوبة. ترتيب مواعيد المقابلات وتسجيل أسماء المراجعين والعملاء في السجلات المخصصة لذلك. الالتزام التام بالأدلة الإجرائية والسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة للعمل والتقيد بها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الاستقبال أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع الزوار والعملاء بمهنية ولباقة. مهارات اتصال ممتازة شفهية وكتابية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية وإدارية جيدة. القدرة على إدارة الوقت وتحديد الأولويات بفعالية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. الالتزام بالتعليمات والإجراءات المحددة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، وتتطلب الوظيفة التفرغ الكامل. سيتم العمل ضمن بيئة احترافية تلتزم بالسياسات والإجراءات الداخلية للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

ea89393eddb3feea.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث معهد تطوير الموارد البشرية العالي للتدريب عن مدرب أعمال وإدارة للانضمام إلى فريقه في الخفجي، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتقديم برامج تدريبية متكاملة في مجال الأعمال والإدارة، مع تقييم أداء المتدربين وضمان تقدمهم الأكاديمي والعملي. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد خطط التدريس النظرية والعملية في حقل الأعمال والإدارة، وتحديد الأهداف التعليمية المباشرة للمناهج. تدريس المواد النظرية في الأعمال والإدارة، وتصميم واختيار التقنيات التربوية وطرق التدريس الفعالة، وتنفيذ وإدارة الدروس. تصميم وتنفيذ وإدارة التطبيقات العملية والميدانية للطلبة، بما في ذلك تصميم الاختبارات العملية وقياس أداء المتدربين. تقييم أداء الطلبة وتحصيلهم الدراسي، وتصميم الاختبارات النظرية لقياس مدى استيعابهم للمادة. تطوير أساليب التدريس وأدوات القياس والتقويم باستمرار لمواكبة التطورات العلمية والتقنية في مجال الأعمال والإدارة. إعداد وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بأداء الطلبة وتحصيلهم وتقدمهم في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التدريب أو التعليم ذي الصلة بالأعمال والإدارة. القدرة على تحليل المناهج الدراسية وتحديد الأهداف التعليمية بوضوح. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والعرض لتقديم المواد التدريبية بفعالية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب التواجد في مدينة الخفجي بالمنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل المدرب ضمن فريق تعليمي متخصص يهدف إلى تقديم أفضل مستويات التدريب للمتدربين. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى معهد تطوير الموارد البشرية العالي للتدريب، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

ea8ef0d8cd3314b9.description: Description Dimensional inspection of castings & forgings against customer specifications and drawings in various stages of casting processes, to ensure the product dimensions meet customer requirements. Dimensional Inspection Carry out dimensional inspection of castings as per drawings & specifications. Measure and accept as per ISO 8062 standard, or as per customer requirement or drawing. Carry out visual inspection of castings and forgings on sample castings. Conduct bulk casting / forgings audit inspection related to dimensional inspection. Ensure casting marking and lettering as per customer drawings and specifications. Equipment & Calibration Maintain measuring and test equipment in the area with calibration status. Non-Conformance & Corrective Action Coordinate with concerned departments for corrective action in case of dimensional deviation on castings. Follow up on casting dimensional correction against the dimensional report if any non-conformity is found. Monitor dimensional related NCR effectiveness. Documentation Maintain dimension reports and relevant documents related to dimensional inspection. Standards Development Develop / assist QC Engineer to develop dimensional inspection standards. Requirements Education ITI / Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or similar qualification (preferred). Experience Minimum 5 years of experience in dimensional inspection. Experience in the steel casting / forging industry is essential. Experience in CMM inspection and programming is preferred. Certifications NDE certification ASNT Level II in Visual Inspection is essential. NDE certification ASNT Level II in MT / PT inspection is preferred. Technical Skills Proficiency in operating inspection equipment and understanding quality standards. Ability to interpret engineering drawings and Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T). Ability to interpret ISO, ASME, and ASTM standards related to dimensional and visual inspection. Knowledge of moulding and core assembly is essential.

ea742893088ea91a.description: Job description Company Description John Crane, a business of Smiths Group, is a global leader in mission-critical flow control solutions for energy and process industries that enable efficient and sustainable operations. Our products include mechanical seals and systems, couplings, filtration systems, and predictive digital monitoring technologies. We have a global network of more than 200 sites in over 50 countries and employ more than 6,000 people worldwide. We partner with our customers to help them keep their operations safe, reduce downtime, improve efficiency, and meet the latest environmental standards. John Crane is part of Smiths Group. For over 170 years, Smiths has been pioneering progress by engineering for a better future. We serve millions of people every year, helping to create a safer, more efficient, productive, and better-connected world across four global markets: energy, security & defence, space & aerospace, and general industrial. Listed on the London Stock Exchange, Smiths employs approximately 16,000 colleagues in over 50 countries. Job Description Job Purpose: Lead and coordinate dedicated project teams in the delivery of projects, including sales, engineering, procurement, quality, Projects/EPC KAMs, Customers/OEMs, and others. Perform project risk evaluation throughout the entire project lifetime; identify issues jeopardizing a successful project completion at an early stage and initiate corrective actions. Coordinate the resolution of any technical or commercial conflicts which may arise at any stage. Act as John Crane's single point of contact to support the customer for post-order activity through to project delivery. Coordinate any post-delivery issue resolution. Maintain communication channels with the client. Responsibilities: Fulfilment of customer contracts (deadlines, costs, objectives) and monitor project budgets closely. Creating and maintaining detailed execution schedules for each of the major projects that are your portfolio. Agreeing communication channels with the customer in relation to the different Project aspects. Managing timely and effective communication with the regional Stakeholders to ensure effective coordination. Regularly communicate with the involved parties and keep constant and updated communication with their various senior-level project management. Attending clarification/kick-off meetings and preparing and distributing relevant activity reports. Work with global and local procurement to ensure that any pre-procurement of long lead items is performed, inventory is maintained and managed, suppliers are performing to expectations, etc. In conjunction with manufacturing operations, ensure the project is completed per the agreed customer schedule and budget. Develop and execute solutions when issues arise that might jeopardize either of these objectives. Record project milestones, maintain records of project correspondence, and produce project close-out summaries, including cost analysis. Support on Coordinating customer change requests to ensure optimal solutions for successful project delivery. Lead frequent team calls to support project execution. Provide monthly reports on project status. Manage quality incidents through eQMS and work closely with assigned incident managers to close the incidents in time and ensure RCA/8Ds are available where applicable. Support process streamlining activities, ISO IQMs compliance, and support SES initiatives. Other project delivery initiative tasks as assigned. Qualifications Technical Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: Degree educated in a technical discipline. Electrical, Mechanical, or Chemical Engineering preferred. Minimum 10 years experience in Project management, preferably in Oil and Gas / Petrochemical projects business. Must be able to read, interpret, and explain complex project specifications. Ability to achieve the agreed goals & objectives by constantly focusing on a set of priorities. Excellent communication, negotiation & presentation skills, both verbal and written. Proper understanding of basic finance. Strong facilitation skills and experience in operating in a matrix environment and adept at swiftly reaching solutions and building consensus under tight deadlines. A PMI Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or a comparable credential is preferred, showcasing a solid foundation in project management methodologies and practices. Experience and knowledge in process improvement methodologies such as Lean Six Sigma are preferred, highlighting a commitment to efficiency and continuous project optimization. Good knowledge of Microsoft suite of products, including MS Project. Preferred experience with Project Lifecycle Management tools (e.g., Teamcenter). Strong level of cultural awareness and capability to adapt behavior accordingly. Fluent in English. Travel up to 15%. Planning and Decision Making: Ability to make quick decisions regarding complex project issues, reducing risk to John Crane and the customer. Develop specific project plans to ensure successful delivery. Empower project team members to make quick decisions to keep projects on track. Impact and Scope: Critical project delivery role influencing the success of strategic, global projects. Working with all regions, internal and external customers. Additional Information With colleagues stretching across the globe, we are proud of our diversity. To foster inclusivity, we run employee resource groups (ERGs) to provide a safe space for employees to connect and support each other. Our cross-business ERGs include Veterans, Pride Network, Black Employee Network, Women@Work Network, and Neurodiversity. Across our company, we recognize excellence, culminating in the Smiths Excellence Awards, our annual celebration of the most extraordinary activities, people, and projects that best showcase our strengths and help drive our business forward. We announce these on our annual Smiths Day, a global celebration of Smiths around our network. Join us for a great career with competitive compensation and benefits, while helping engineer a better future. We believe that different perspectives and backgrounds are what make a company flourish. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment regardless of color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, economic status, disability, age, or any other legally protected characteristics. We are proud to be an inclusive company with values grounded in equality and ethics, where we celebrate, support, and embrace diversity. At no time during the hiring process will Smiths Group, nor any of our recruitment partners ever request payment to enable participation – including, but not limited to, interviews or testing. eaadfe7838b1c125.description: About Echelon Echelon is a Saudi technology company focused on bringing global AI technologies to the Kingdom. Manage committee operations, including preparing agendas, packs, minutes, decisions, and actions for the Partner Pipeline and Partner Activation Committees, and ensuring follow-through between meetings. Administer revenue share processes, including deal registration, milestone confirmation against the 50/80/100 percent curve, invoicing, collections, and reconciliation with Finance. Oversee partner onboarding, which involves contract filing and NDAs with Legal, providing portal and tool access, conducting enablement sessions and events, and managing a partner’s first ninety days. Generate reports such as pipeline, coverage, and Partnership Health dashboards, the quarterly partner review pack, and inputs for the five-year model. Spreadsheet Proficiency: Strong skills in building and maintaining accurate trackers and transforming them into reliable dashboards. Customer Focus: Measures work by customer outcomes and prioritizes accordingly. Ownership Mentality: Takes end-to-end ownership of outcomes and proactively addresses issues. Clear Communication: Explains complex information simply to diverse audiences and highlights the value of work. Comfort with Ambiguity: Capable of making progress with incomplete information and enjoys problem-solving in unstructured environments. Long-term Builder: Invests in Echelon’s long-term success by integrating learnings into strategy and operations. Curiosity: Reads and understands partner agreements, and can clearly explain concepts like take rates, milestones, and revenue-share curves.
